meta.title: AgentBridge — MCP Session & Connector Lifecycle State Machine
meta.subtitle: Transport Connection, Handshake Negotiation, Readiness & Degradation
meta.description: Lifecycle finite-state machine governing MCP client sessions from DISCONNECTED through CONNECTING, version negotiation, capability exchange, READY state, runtime ping DEGRADED status, error recovery, and clean session shutdown.

states.label: DISCONNECTED
states.description: Initial dormant state. Transport is closed. Invocations raise ConnectorNotConnectedError.

states.label: Open Transport
states.description: Session transitions to CONNECTING. Calls transport.open() asynchronously.

states.label: CONNECTING
states.description: Transport link is live; protocol initialization handshake is initiated.

states.label: Protocol Handshake
states.description: Sends initialize request with client capabilities and latest protocol version (2026-07-28).

states.label: Handshake Succeeded?
states.description: Verifies server response, negotiates supported protocol version, and checks capabilities.

states.label: Send notifications/initialized
states.description: Confirms protocol establishment by transmitting initialized notification.

states.label: READY
states.description: Session fully initialized. Tools, resources, and prompts operations are active.

states.label: Diagnostic Ping
states.description: connector.health() or client.ping() verifies server liveness and round-trip latency.

states.label: Ping Healthy?
states.description: Checks if ping responds within threshold without transport error.

states.label: DEGRADED
states.description: Session remains connected but ping timed out or failed. Health check reports DEGRADED.

states.label: ERROR
states.description: Transport connection dropped, handshake rejected, or unrecoverable protocol fault.

states.label: Close & Teardown
states.description: Gracefully cancels pending operations and closes the underlying transport.

states.label: CLOSED / DISCONNECTED
states.description: Terminal clean state. All resources released.
